title: Isolated gate bias power supply design
purpose: Choose and design the isolated supply for each SiC gate driver: topology, rail generation, power budget, isolation capacitance, regulation and input protection.
applicable_conditions: Isolated SiC gate drivers needing floating bipolar or unipolar supplies
Regulated low-voltage auxiliary input (12 V in the references)
principles: P = Q_G * f_sw * (V_DD - V_EE) budget per supply with margin
Minimise isolation capacitance; i = C_iso * dv/dt
CM choke at converter input with capacitor between choke and converter
Rails around the source via dual outputs, Zener split or LDOs
Regulate only as needed; LDO headroom >= 0.3 V
procedure: Choose rail generation and compute operating points
Verify isolation rating and estimate i_CM
component_considerations: Integrated module UCC14141-Q1 (rating depends on input range)
Discrete LLC: UCC25800-Q1 with low-capacitance transformer
pcb_constraints: Supply inside its driver island, straddling the barrier with creepage (KR-ISO-001, KR-ISO-004)
CM choke and input capacitor order (KR-IS-002)
Output capacitors in the gate loop (KR-PCB-002)
verification_methods: Measure rails versus load and input; ripple during switching; common-mode current/EMI
known_limitations: Module datasheets not verified for two parts
